_comment: Guild ranks (game/ranks.py), lowest first. User's choices: placeholder names; a Hunter earns a rank (hunts completed and a level), then sits for it at the guild clerk for a fee; ranks gate which gates' boards are open (regions) and how dangerous a contract you may take (max_danger), and bring privileges. A new Hunter starts at the first rank. NAMES AND NUMBERS ARE PLACEHOLDERS. Privileges: training_discount (off every skill training fee), request_bonus (extra pay for filling requests), first_pick (you may take a contract a rival has already taken today). Debt (user: both): labour_per_pulse is what a Pulse of Guild labour pays down; still owing when the next dues fall due (the next Judgment) costs a rank.
